title: test(app-shell): signOutPurge patches through a render that holds the attached preference family
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7QKW2SoBTqFr5fFcTpE76m)_

Fixes #32346

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 `signOutPurge.test.tsx` 的测试搭建。探针改为每次提交写一份快照（会话与列表状态同出一次渲染），登录辅助函数等「同一份快照里既是 Alice 的会话、又报告她的状态已读」后，经这份快照写入；五个用例都走这个辅助函数。产品代码不动。
- 为什么改：探针的引用在 passive effect 里写，落后于屏幕。负载下「ready」的等待可能在未登录的渲染上通过（没有用户就无需等待），随后的写入走的是 Alice 的第一次渲染，那时服务端偏好族还没挂上：改动只写进本浏览器，从未排队保存，于是用例 1–3 在保存断言处红（`family.save` 未调用，或事件序列只有 `session ended`）。
- 风险与回滚：仅测试文件，`@object-ui/app-shell` 为私有包，无 changeset；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：测试文件里的 `signIn` 辅助函数与 `Committed` 快照。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/signOutPurge.test.tsx`，预期 5 passed；负载复现方法见下文 Verification。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/signOutPurge.test.tsx` only:

- The probe writes one `Committed` snapshot per commit (`{ auth, prefs }`), replacing the two refs `authRef` and `prefsRef`, so the session and the list state it reads always come from the same render.
- A new `signIn(client, family)` helper renders the console and waits for ONE snapshot that holds Alice's session and reports `ready`, then returns that snapshot's list-state handle. The patch goes through that handle.
- `signInAndFilter` (cases 1, 3, 4, 5) and the inline sign-in of case 2 both use `signIn`. Assertions are unchanged.

No product file changes.

## Why

The failing link is the first of the seat's two suspects: the patch lands before the server family is attached, so the write is local-only and nothing is queued to send. It is the test's setup, not the product.

The probe wrote its refs in a passive effect, which runs after commit, so the refs trailed the screen:

1. The first wait (`getByTestId('user')` reads "Alice") can pass while the refs still hold the signed-out render. Measured: the snapshot read right after that wait was the signed-out one in 2 of 160 runs.
2. A signed-out render reports `ready: true` (`ListPreferencesProvider` has no user to wait for), so the second wait passed on it.
3. RTL's `waitFor` drains a macrotask before it resolves. During that drain the pending effects ran, and the refs moved to Alice's FIRST render. In that render the bridge has not attached the family yet (`FamilyBridge` attaches it in that commit's effects), so `update` closes over `family === null`.
4. `patchView` through that handle wrote Alice's local key (so `userState` read correctly) and returned before queueing a save. No debounce timer, no sign-out flush, no family-detach flush had anything to send, and `family.save` was never called.

Measured with temporary logging in `ListPreferencesProvider.update` (reverted, not in this diff): 2 of 300 patches ran with `family === null` while the user was Alice, in each of two loaded runs. The same render log showed Alice's first render with `family=false` immediately before each such patch. The no-family wait timer never fired.

A real user cannot reach this: a list opens only once `ready` is true, and in Alice's first render `ready` is false. Only the test's after-commit refs could hand out that render's closure.

Cases 4 and 5 assert no save, so they stayed green while silently patching through the same stale handle. They now use the same helper.

## Verification

Load reproduction: N copies of the file run in one vitest invocation from `ui/` with `--sequence.shuffle` and vitest's default thread pool on a 4-core box, with 8 busy-loop processes saturating the CPU. Each copy is the file under a new name beside it (`zzreproN.signOutPurge.test.tsx`), all passed to one `pnpm exec vitest run --sequence.shuffle …` call; the copies were deleted after each run and are not in this diff.

| Tree | Load | Copies | Tests red |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| `main` 898c2f46 | 4 burners | 60 | 0 / 300 |
| `main` 898c2f46 | 8 burners | 100 | 2 / 500 (case 2, events held only `session ended`) |
| `main` + test logging | 8 burners | 40 | 1 / 200 (case 1, `family.save` not called, the CI failure) |
| `main` + provider logging | 8 burners | 60 + 60 | 1 / 300 (case 3), 2 / 300 |
| this branch | 8 burners | 100 | **0 / 500** |
| this branch + provider logging | 8 burners | 100 | **0 / 500**, and 500 of 500 patches ran with the family attached |

The failure rate on `main` is about 1 to 2 file runs in 100 under saturation, too low for a green run alone to prove much. The logged run is the stronger evidence: the mechanism (a patch with no family) occurred 2 times in 300 before and 0 times in 500 after.

Gates on `8770a19f`, run under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/signOutPurge.test.tsx`: 5 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (covers `src/**/*.test.tsx` through `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `npx eslint src/context/__tests__/signOutPurge.test.tsx` from the package: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 26 derived families, all exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: "26 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 26 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- No changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and the diff publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).
